messages:
maria: :rotating_light: getting reports that Pager sent alerts to infra-team instead of SRE oncall. customer-facing retries lagging, seeing elevated 5xx.
raj: seeing the same — alert cluster: notify-service 5xx spike at 18:32 UTC. Did incidentbot route change recently?
incident-bot: [system] Paging triggered: notify-service-high-5xx -> escalation_policy: infra-pager (triggered by alert id: alert-8421)
eric: that policy is wrong for this alert. It should have gone to oncall-sre. I think the mapping rule for notify-service got an extra tag match after the config deploy this morning.
sophie: I deployed a small change to routing rules at 10:10; intended to add env:staging whitelist but maybe the YAML indented wrong. rolling back now.
raj: can you paste the diff? we need to confirm the regression and whether pages were retriggered.
sophie: diff snippet:
```
- service: notify-service
- escalation: oncall-sre
+ service: notify-service
+ escalation: infra-pager   # unintended override due to env:prod match
```
eric: looks like a mistaken merge from a feature branch. The unit test for policy mapping didn't cover overlapping tags. ops-runner, can you intervene and remap temporarily?
ops-runner: remapped the alert to oncall-sre at 18:38 UTC and re-fired the alert. New page went to oncall SRE.
maria: how many customer-facing errors were impacted? any payment or auth flows affected?
raj: initial estimate: ~3k failed webhook attempts over 4 minutes. One enterprise customer (acme-inc) saw webhook retries fail and manually contacted support. No data loss, retries succeeded after ~5m.
sophie: opened INC-2026-0421 for tracking. tagging in runbook: "paging-mapping-regression". I'll start a postmortem doc and include deploy rollback details.
eric: action items: 1) revert config (done), 2) add integration test covering overlapping tag precedence, 3) add a safety check in deploy pipeline that diff-checks escalation policy changes and requires a manual approval for routing edits.
raj: also please resend any missed pages to oncall log so oncall rotation count is correct. ops-runner already fired a manual page.
ops-runner: confirmed manual pages: 2 retries sent, oncall acknowledged. I also triggered automated reconciliation (incidentbot requeue) for alerts between 18:30-18:40.
incident-bot: [system] Incident INC-2026-0421 created by sophie. Severity: P2. Affected: notify-service. Pages: 4 (2 manual requeue).
maria: customer comms — support already sent an initial note to acme-inc. Ops/Support please consolidate and include ETA and mitigation steps.
sophie: assigning follow-ups: @eric test coverage, @raj postmortem notes, @maria customer comms liaison. I'll own the deploy approval change.
eric: starting a small PR for tests now, will link to the incident doc.
raj: adding timeline to the incident doc. please drop any logs/screens here.
maria: thanks everyone. once postmortem is up, let's schedule a quick blameless review with oncall rotation leads to prevent mapping-only deploys slipping through.
ops-runner: :thumbsup: marking incident as mitigated for live impact at 18:44 UTC. monitoring still noisy, we'll watch for recurrence.
sophie: postmortem draft link: https://redwood-internal/pm/INC-2026-0421 (will add timeline + commit/hash)
eric: noted commit: 3a9f2b4 — introduced env tag change in routing.yaml
maria: closing loop — support to followup with affected customer tomorrow morning. Good catch and quick rollback team. :heart:
